import { requirePrivateAccountMessage } from '@src/utils/privateAccountMessage';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 设置密码指令
 * 支持设置和修改官网登录密码
 * 指令格式：/设置密码 [密码]
 * 密码要求：至少6位
 */
import { getSetPasswordData } from '@src/response-apps/emailSecurity/setPassword/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  if (!(await requirePrivateAccountMessage(e))) {
    return;
  }
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const result = await getSetPasswordData(uid, e.UserId, isPrivate, e.MessageText, createBackendRequestContext(e));

  const sendText = (text: string) => {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(text);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '设置密码', content: md }));
  };

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'NOT_PRIVATE':
      sendText('请私聊发送指令以保护账号安全');

      return;
    case 'NO_PASSWORD':
      sendText(`请输入密码，格式：/设置密码 [密码]\n密码至少${result.minLength}位`);

      return;
    case 'TOO_SHORT':
      sendText(`密码至少${result.minLength}位，请重新输入`);

      return;
    case 'USER_NOT_FOUND':
      sendText('用户信息未找到，请先注册账号');

      return;
    case 'OK': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('✅ 密码设置成功！');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`平台ID：${result.bid}`);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`游戏ID：${result.uid}`);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('⚠️ 请妥善保管密码，不要泄露给他人');

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '设置密码',
          content: md,
          footer: [{ label: '安全中心', command: '/安全中心' }]
        })
      );
    }
  }
});
